summary: Silicom Ltd. filed a 6-K providing notice of its Annual General Meeting on June 3, 2026, with agenda items including re-election of a director, executive compensation increases, and RSU grants. This is a routine shareholder meeting notice (equivalent to a Schedule 14A proxy filing for US issuers). No forced or abrupt management departure is disclosed; the proposed director re-election and compensation adjustments are ordinary course. Accordingly, this filing does not constitute a special-situation event under the defined categories, and 'Management Changes' applies only tentatively given the low threshold for routine board elections.
